name: Montgomery
gaps: Parcels are NC/Montgomery Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://www.webgis.net/arcgis/rest/services/NC/Montgomery/MapServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 6024 rows; 5957 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 res (tax ok, sale ok). Pass 2 counted 398 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
